verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes multiple downloadable OpenAPI JSON specs (domains-v3.json, domains-v1.json, domains-v2.json, catalog-graphql.json, orders.json, stores.json, customers.json, commerce-taxes.json, channels.json) directly at developer.godaddy.com/openapi/*, plus an llms.txt index pointing to them as 'machine-readable Domains contract'. This directly satisfies the ask for a downloadable machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that these specs are complete, versioned, and actively maintained (only first-party docs cited).
